newsitem.title: USA: Weyco sets stock dividend, raises payout.
newsitem.headline: Weyco sets stock dividend, raises payout.

text.p: Weyco Group Inc, which makes and distributes men's shoes, said Monday it declared a 200 percent stock dividend on its common stock.
It also raised its quarterly dividend by four percent to $0.08 a share, adjusted for the stock dividend.
The 200 percent stock dividend effects a three-for-one stock split without a change in par value, it added.
Before the stock dividend, Weyco's quarter dividend rate had been $0.23 a share.
Weyco said the additional shares in the stock dividend will be mailed October 1 to shareholders of record as of September 2.
The pay date for the quarterly dividend will be October 1 for shareholders of record on September 2.
